The activity coordinate Xi is its image in the common completed activity chart. At a fixed finite horizon all these coordinates live in one finite product of their scalar and activity spaces. Let γ = 1/128. The actual local analytic comparison, including the initial state at N, bounds differences of activity outputs by 8γ times the maximum input-coordinate difference.
